segments.he: גְּמָ׳: תָּנָא לֹא יֵצֵא הַגָּמָל בִּמְטוּלְטֶלֶת הַקְּשׁוּרָה לוֹ בִּזְנָבוֹ, אֲבָל יוֹצֵא הוּא בִּמְטוּלְטֶלֶת הַקְּשׁוּרָה בִּזְנָבוֹ וּבְחוֹטַרְתּוֹ. אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא: יוֹצֵא הַגָּמָל בִּמְטוּלְטֶלֶת הַקְּשׁוּרָה לוֹ בְּשִׁילְיְיתָא.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «It was taught» in the Tosefta: «A camel may not go out with a saddlecloth tied to its tail» alone. «However, it may go out with a saddlecloth tied to» both «its tail and its hump,» as in that case one can assume that the saddlecloth will not fall off. «Rabba bar Rav Huna said: A» female «camel may go out with a saddlecloth tied to its afterbirth.» Because any movement of the saddlecloth will cause pain, the animal will not attempt to detach it. Therefore, there is no room for concern lest it fall.
